verdict.rationale: Weave is an observability platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server applies, and W&B documents one. Per its docs it gives coding agents like Claude Code direct access to runs, traces, evaluations and artifacts for natural-language debugging, alongside Skills covering Weave traces and evals and a REST Service API for programmatic access. The probe confirms an official wandb-mcp-server repo exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent querying, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and detail on which metric and query operations the MCP tools expose.
